SOURCES.conflict: Raw merge would regress current Reality consumption and resurrect an owner-rejected visual baseline.
SOURCES.recommended_action: Do not merge or reuse as an approved visual baseline; retain only traceable negative evidence and any still-unaccounted nonvisual gene.

SOURCES.head: af83c306f67a7b63d44c1b810dd660ea9deca8dc

SOURCES.recommended_action: Adapt the bridge into canonical evidence and creative seams without copying the rejected UI or activating a provider.

SOURCES.head: 88adc037a2e6eecbfe8903b5e2d58c2bc4cc1345

SOURCES.head: 593be6303d0c3f281a4581982d41c8cad2754837

SOURCES.head: c4e3e895a9fe7728de61f395e1f6181966385cb2
SOURCES.unique_gene: One Reality-backed Customer World across home, search, delivery, dispensaries, list/map and merchant profiles
SOURCES.recommended_action: Extend without rebuilding; preserve its truth and route contracts through every visual change.

DO_NOT_RESCAN_SET: PR #21 functional routes and identity laws are accounted for by PR #47; only its owner-rejected visual evidence remains relevant.
PR #28 through PR #32 may not create another entity, truth, projection or search system.
PR #33 remains an isolated merchant-media donor.
PR #34 remains the bounded visual-token donor for the next slice.
PR #11, #22, #24 and #25 remain creative/provider donors with zero authority to spend, publish or self-certify.
